mobile.session.conversation_details.note: The destination screen's own title, used as the label of the control that opens it — not an action verb. It must stay identical wherever that screen is named, including the sentence in mobile.home.options.fixed, so a reader recognises the same destination. No final full stop.

mobile.session.status_tray.hint.note: Accessibility hint read after the status tray's label. Describes what activating the tray opens; no final full stop. "Subagents" is a product term.

mobile.session.highlights.withheld.note: Quiet line under a highlights block naming deliverables that were refused. {count} counts files; {reasons} is one or more of the withheld_* reason phrases, already translated; when several apply the app joins them pairwise with mobile.session.highlights.withheld_reasons_join. No final full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.withheld_outsi.note: Reason phrase inside mobile.session.highlights.withheld: the file lies outside the folders the app may show. Lower case, no full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.withheld_sensi.note: Reason phrase inside mobile.session.highlights.withheld: the file looks like a credential or secret and is never shown. Lower case, no full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.withheld_missi.note: Reason phrase inside mobile.session.highlights.withheld: the named file was deleted or never written. Lower case, no full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.withheld_too_l.note: Reason phrase inside mobile.session.highlights.withheld: the file exceeds the preview size limit. Lower case, no full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.sound_play.note: Accessibility label of a sound cell's play control. {title} is the sound's own name, copied verbatim. No full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.sound_pause.note: Accessibility label of a sound cell's control while it plays. {title} is the sound's own name. No full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.sound_untitled.note: Stand-in name for a sound with no title, used inside the play/pause labels. One noun.

mobile.session.highlights.video_open.note: Accessibility label of a video tile that starts playback. {name} is the file name, verbatim. No full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.sounds_more.note: Line under the sounds grid when the row held back sounds beyond its bound. {count} counts sounds. No final full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.sound_refused.note: Shown under a sound cell when its bytes could not be fetched. {reason} is the relay's own sentence, passed through untranslated. No final full stop.

mobile.session.highlights.withheld_reaso.note: Joins two reason phrases (or an already-joined list and one more) inside the withheld line. A bare list separator — use your locale's enumeration comma, never a word for "and". Keep both placeholders.

mobile.session.subagent_open.note: Accessibility label of the small `open` control on a subagent's message in the transcript; activating it opens that subagent's own view. {agent} is the subagent's label or job ID exactly as the app shows it, never translated. An imperative verb, no final full stop.

mobile.session.subagent_open_short.note: Visible text of the small control on a subagent's message in the transcript that opens that subagent's own view; screen readers hear mobile.session.subagent_open instead. Shown in lower case beside quiet meta text: keep it one short word, lower case where the script has case, no final full stop.
